rust_summary: Natural spawning checks a mob's maximum cluster size (`native_spawn_cluster_size`).
doc_summary: Natural spawning checks the maximum cluster size on the server: `native_spawn_cluster_size(kind, position, size)` corresponds to NeoForge's `SpawnClusterSizeEvent` at `NaturalSpawner.spawnCategoryForPosition`. Change `size` to replace the maximum. Horizon supplies the mob type and position rather than an entity ID because it assigns IDs later. Bundles need "hooks": @API:spawn_cluster_size@.
